segments.contextAfter: `connectivity`: An enumeration that specifies which pixels the operation includes as neighbors. Pass [`vImage.FloodFillConnectivity.edges`](vimage/floodfillconnectivity/edges.md) to specify a four-connected neighborhood of a pixel that includes the pixels to the left and right, and those above and below. Pass [`vImage.FloodFillConnectivity.edgesAndCorners`](vimage/floodfillconnectivity/edgesandcorners.md) to specify an eight-connected neighborhood that includes the four-connected neighborhood and the pixels on the four diagonals.
